# Damaged or wrong item

- **Items of ₹500 or more**: yes, but you don't pay. In India a courier collects it for free; abroad we pay the return shipping.

For a replacement, we send the new item when the courier has collected the old one. For a refund, the money arrives 5–7 business days after the item reaches our warehouse, or after we approve your photo for items under ₹500.

## What happens next

We reply within 2 business days. If the fault is covered, we repair the item or send you a replacement. In India a courier collects the item for free; from abroad, please ask us before sending anything. If we can't repair or replace it, we offer a refund, which a member of our team approves.

Taking care of your gear helps it last: see [Caring for your waterproof backpack](backpack-care) and [Setting up your tent](tent-setup).

## How to start a return

1. Sign in, open **Orders**, choose the order and press **Return an item**. If you checked out as a guest, email support@tidewater.example with your order ID (it looks like TW-10423) and the item you are sending back.
2. Pack the item with its tags, in its original packaging if you still have it.
3. **In India**, pickup is free: a courier collects the parcel from your address within 3 business days. You don't need to print anything.
4. **Outside India**, please send the parcel yourself to the address below with a tracked service. International customers pay the return shipping.

Tidewater Goods Returns
Unit 4, Harbour Road Industrial Estate
Kochi, Kerala 682003, India

# Damaged or wrong item

## Tell us within 48 hours

Email support@tidewater.example **within 48 hours of delivery** with:

- your order ID (it looks like TW-10423),
- a photo of the item showing the damage, or of the wrong item with its label, and
- a photo of the outer box if it was damaged too.

Reports after 48 hours are handled as normal returns, so the item then has to be unused, with tags, and within 30 days of delivery (see [Returns](returns-policy)). Faults that appear later on a jacket, backpack or tent may be covered by the [warranty](warranty-claims).

We refund within **5–7 business days after your return reaches our warehouse and passes inspection**. Business days are Monday to Saturday, except public holidays. Inspection means we check that the item is unused and has its tags (see [Returns](returns-policy)).

Every refund is checked and approved by a member of our support team before it is paid. We never pay refunds automatically.

## Returns from abroad

You can return items within 30 days of delivery, like everyone else, but international customers pay the return shipping. Send the parcel to our Kochi warehouse with a tracked service; the address is in [Returns](returns-policy). We can't refund duties or taxes you paid on import; your country's customs office may be able to.

## Still not sure?

- If you are usually an M in T-shirts, you are usually an M in our jackets too.
- The Coastal Light Shell is the snuggest; many people size up in it.

## How each jacket fits

| Jacket | SKU | Fit | Sizes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Coastal Light Shell | JKT-COASTAL | Slim: close to the body for walking and cycling | S, M, L, XL |
| Monsoon Rain Jacket | JKT-MONSOON | Regular: room for a T-shirt and a light fleece | S, M, L, XL |
| Storm Pro Jacket | JKT-STORM | Relaxed: room for a warm layer, longer at the back | M, L, XL |

The size goes at the end of the SKU: a medium Monsoon Rain Jacket is JKT-MONSOON-M.

# Jacket size guide

All our jackets use the same body measurements. Measure your chest at its fullest point, under your arms, with a soft tape, then find your size below.

| Size | Chest (cm) | Back length (cm) | Sleeve (cm) |
|---|---|---|---|
| S | 88–96 | 70 | 61 |
| M | 96–104 | 72 | 63 |
| L | 104–112 | 74 | 65 |
| XL | 112–120 | 76 | 67 |

If you are between two sizes, choose the larger one if you will wear a fleece or thick layer underneath.

# Waterproof ratings explained

## Fabric: millimetres of water column

For jackets and tents we give a number in millimetres (mm), also called hydrostatic head. Picture a tall tube standing on the fabric and filling with water: the rating is how high the water can rise before drops come through. 10,000 mm means a column of water 10 metres high.

| Rating | What it handles | Our products |
|---|---|---|
| 1,500 mm | Light drizzle and short showers | None (we don't sell anything below 3,000 mm) |
| 3,000 mm | Steady rain for an hour or two | Tent flysheets (Compact, Solo and Family tents) |

| 10,000 mm | Heavy rain for hours | Monsoon Rain Jacket |
| 20,000 mm | All-day monsoon downpours, with straps pressing on your shoulders | Storm Pro Jacket |

- pegs and guy lines, and
- a repair sleeve for a damaged pole.

# Setting up your Tidewater tent

## Putting it up

1. **Choose the spot.** Flat, a little higher than the ground around it so rain runs away, and clear of stones and sticks. Never in a dry river bed.
2. **Lay the footprint** (sold separately as ACC-TENT-FOOTPRINT-2 for the 2-person tent) and the inner tent on it, door facing away from the wind.
3. **Assemble the poles** and match each pole's colour to the clips of the same colour on the inner tent. Push the pole ends into the corner eyelets.
4. **Clip the inner tent** onto the poles, from the bottom up.
5. **Throw the flysheet over**, match its colours to the poles, and buckle it at each corner.
6. **Peg it out.** Push pegs in at 45 degrees, leaning away from the tent. Tension the guy lines until the flysheet is tight and doesn't touch the inner tent anywhere; where they touch, water seeps through.

# Caring for your waterproof backpack

## Using the roll-top

On the DryTrek and Roll-Top backpacks, fold the top over at least three times before you clip the buckle. Fewer folds let water in. These backpacks are rated IPX6: they keep out heavy rain and splashes, but they are not made to go under water. For that, use a dry bag inside.

## After every trip

- **Empty it** and shake out sand and grit; grit wears the zips.
- **Rinse with fresh water** after the beach or a boat. Salt dries into crystals that stiffen the fabric and corrode buckles.
- **Dry it open, in the shade.** Hang it upside down with the zips and roll-top open. Strong sun for days on end fades the fabric and weakens the coating.

# Waterproof ratings explained

## Bags and pouches: IP ratings

Bags and pouches use an IP rating instead. The second digit is about water:

| Rating | What it means | Our products |
|---|---|---|
| IPX4 | Splashes from any direction | Monsoon Commuter Backpack |
| IPX6 | Strong jets of water, heavy rain | DryTrek and Roll-Top backpacks, roll-top dry bags |
| IPX8 | Under water: our pouches are tested at 2 m for 30 minutes | Phone pouches, waist pouch, document pouch |

Nothing on this page is a promise for diving: a phone pouch is for rain, boats and swimming at the surface.

# Waterproof ratings explained

## Fabric: millimetres of water column

For jackets and tents we give a number in millimetres (mm), also called hydrostatic head. Picture a tall tube standing on the fabric and filling with water: the rating is how high the water can rise before drops come through. 10,000 mm means a column of water 10 metres high.

| 1,500 mm | Light drizzle and short showers | None (we don't sell anything below 3,000 mm) |
| 3,000 mm | Steady rain for an hour or two | Tent flysheets (Compact, Solo and Family tents) |

| 20,000 mm | All-day monsoon downpours, with straps pressing on your shoulders | Storm Pro Jacket |

- If a zip gets stiff, rub a little candle wax or zip lubricant along the teeth. Never force it.

- An order gets the sale price only if it is placed between 00:00 IST on the first day and 23:59 IST on the last day of the sale.

# Bulk and corporate orders

## How to ask for a quote

Email bulk@tidewater.example with:

- the products and quantities (sizes too, for jackets and sandals),
- the delivery address and the date you need them by, and
- your company's name and GSTIN, if you want a GST invoice for input credit.

# Ways to pay: UPI, cards, net banking, cash on delivery and EMI

## Invoices

Every order's GST invoice is attached to the shipping email and can be downloaded from **Orders**. To claim GST input credit for a business, enter your GSTIN at checkout; we can't add it to an invoice afterwards.

## Returns and warranty

Sale items follow our normal rules: returns within 30 days of delivery, unused and with tags, and the usual warranty on tents, backpacks and jackets. Refunds are for the sale price you paid.

## Still not sure?

- If you are usually an M in T-shirts, you are usually an M in our jackets too.
- The Coastal Light Shell is the snuggest; many people size up in it.
- Email support@tidewater.example with your height and chest measurement and we will suggest a size.

Unused items without a logo can be returned within 30 days of delivery, like any order. For returns of more than 10 items, please email us first so we can arrange a single pickup.

## What happens next

When the parcel reaches our warehouse in Kochi, we check that the item is unused and has its tags. If it passes, we refund you; see [Refunds: when and where your money goes](refunds). If it doesn't pass, we send it back to you and explain why.

# Returns: how to send something back

## Exchanges

We don't swap items directly. To change a size or colour, return the item for a refund and place a new order; that way the new one ships straight away instead of waiting for the return. The [jacket size guide](jacket-size-guide) may save you a return.

# Damaged or wrong item

Sorry about that. If something arrives damaged, faulty out of the box, or isn't what you ordered, we will put it right.

# Cancelling an order

## Already packed?

Once an order's status is **Packed** or **Shipped**, we can't stop it. Let it arrive, then return it within 30 days of delivery. In India the return pickup is free. See [Returns](returns-policy).

# Damaged or wrong item

## Tell us within 48 hours

Email support@tidewater.example **within 48 hours of delivery** with:

- your order ID (it looks like TW-10423),
- a photo of the item showing the damage, or of the wrong item with its label, and
- a photo of the outer box if it was damaged too.

Reports after 48 hours are handled as normal returns, so the item then has to be unused, with tags, and within 30 days of delivery (see [Returns](returns-policy)). Faults that appear later on a jacket, backpack or tent may be covered by the [warranty](warranty-claims).

# Damaged or wrong item

## Do I need to send it back?

- **Items under ₹500** (for example a phone pouch, a document pouch or seam sealer): no. Keep it or recycle it; we don't need it back.
- **Items of ₹500 or more**: yes, but you don't pay. In India a courier collects it for free; abroad we pay the return shipping.

For a replacement, we send the new item when the courier has collected the old one. For a refund, the money arrives 5–7 business days after the item reaches our warehouse, or after we approve your photo for items under ₹500.
